landmarks.name: Colosseum
landmarks.hint: The world's largest ancient amphitheatre, once hosting gladiatorial contests and public spectacles

landmarks.name: St. Peter's Basilica
landmarks.hint: The largest church in the world, crowned by Michelangelo's dome in Vatican City

landmarks.name: Trevi Fountain
landmarks.hint: The largest Baroque fountain in Rome; tradition says tossing a coin ensures your return

landmarks.name: Spanish Steps
landmarks.hint: A monumental stairway of 135 steps leading from Piazza di Spagna to the Trinità dei Monti church

landmarks.name: Pantheon
landmarks.hint: A remarkably preserved ancient temple turned church, famous for its unreinforced concrete dome

landmarks.name: Roman Forum
landmarks.hint: The central plaza of ancient Rome, surrounded by ruins of important government buildings

landmarks.name: Borghese Gallery
landmarks.hint: A magnificent art gallery inside the Villa Borghese, housing Bernini sculptures and Caravaggio paintings

landmarks.name: Piazza Navona
landmarks.hint: A lively Baroque piazza built over the ancient Stadium of Domitian, with Bernini's Fountain of the Four Rivers

landmarks.name: Castel Sant'Angelo
landmarks.hint: A towering cylindrical mausoleum initially built for Emperor Hadrian, later a papal fortress

landmarks.name: Appian Way
landmarks.hint: One of the earliest and most important Roman roads, lined with ancient tombs and catacombs
